messages:
sam: Quick weekly release train checkpoint — please read. Deploy for train v2026.09 is scheduled tonight. Freeze window starts 23:00 UTC for public API routes. Canary rollout will begin at 23:15 UTC with 2% traffic, stepping to 10% over 30m. Link: https://go/redwood/release-train/2026.09 :shipit:

maria: Heads-up — canary metrics: embeddings service p99 jumped ~300ms in staging earlier. Investigating, may reduce canary target if persists.

chen: Thanks. I have a rollback artifact ready (tag: v2026.09-rollback-1). If we see >1.5% error or >20% latency reg, we should rollback.

priya: QA — please run smoke + auth gating tests on the canary stack. I've queued nightly test-suite: `./scripts/run_smoke.sh --targets=auth,generate`.

omar: Ops — routing flip scheduled at 23:45 UTC for non-critical routes. I'll monitor with dashboards. Paging @oncall if we hit errors.

sre-bot: Deploy pipeline started for v2026.09 (build 5182). Logs: https://ci.redwood/builds/5182 :rocket:

dev-bot: CI: all checks passed (unit, integration, lint). Canary job OK.

maria: Update — root cause looks like a KV cache miss spike after model patch. Working on a mitigation (cache warmers) now.

sam: Important policy note: release freeze reminder — no UI or infra migrations during freeze. Emergency exceptions must be approved by Eng Leads + SRE.

chen: Ack. We'll only push hotfixes with signed-off changelogs.

priya: QA acked locally. Will report smoke pass/fail in 10m.

omar: Ops ack. I’ll keep the incident channel open: #release-ops and ping oncall when thresholds cross.

maria: Smoke passed on canary so far — 15m monitoring looks stable. :thumbsup:

sam: Thanks everyone. If you can't attend the rollout window, reply here. We'll proceed unless a clear blocker shows up. TL;DR: Freeze 23:00 UTC, canary 23:15 -> ramp, rollback plan in place.

chen: ack

priya: ack

omar: ack

sre-bot: Reminder: SLA change doc published: https://go/redwood/sla/2026-update — please review before EOD.

sam: Closing thread — will post final status after ramp completes.
